item.title: Kinda unglued: Why AI agents are hiding their tracks
item.description:
Top AI execs agree the tech has a problem...
Thank you for being here, friend. The Golden Girls debuted on this day in 1985. Some Monday motivation: The show’s matriarch, Sophia, was only supposed to be an occasional presence. But the audience for the pilot episode became enamored of Estelle Getty’s portrayal, and she got promoted to a starring role. Literally main character energy.

item.title: Hiring Brew: How to survive the AI hiring gauntlet
item.description:
There are two sides to every job posting...
Good morning. We are writing this note to express our strong interest in welcoming you to Hiring Brew. Our background has equipped us to provide you with insights into how AI has swarmed both hiring and applying, the most bizarre questions that tech companies are asking interviewees these days, what “work trials” are and how job seekers are navigating them, and more. Looking forward to connecting!
